project_context.name: Atties
project_context.description: AI web designing startup landing page
project_context.reference_style: MindMarket (mindmarket.com) - High-contrast, bold typography, brutalist structural elements
project_context.brand_logo: Bold yellow block-letter 'ATTIES' with pink/purple outline on dark background, tagline 'AI WEB DESIGNERS'

fonts.headings: Unbounded or Cabinet Grotesk (Wide Display Sans - highly structural and modern)
fonts.body: JetBrains Mono or Space Mono (Adds a developer/tech edge)

rules: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato for headings.
H1 must be clamped and massive (e.g., text-5xl md:text-7xl) with tracking-tighter.
Never center-align paragraphs or dense content; strictly left-align.
Use ALL CAPS with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and tiny labels.
No pure black #000000 - use the tinted void black #050505.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Always use bg-black/80 with backdrop-blur-xl.
Hover states MUST have explicitly higher contrast colors defined (e.g., hover:bg-yellow-400 hover:text-black).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders & Retro-Futurism. Make the grid visible using border-collapse style layouts with 1px border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid soft/blurred shadows. Use hard offset neo-brutalist shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#FACC15]) on interactive buttons and cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Integrate a subtle noise/grain overlay fixed over the background to remove digital flatness.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x typical spacing (py-24, gap-12). Prioritize breathing room.
layouts.header: Sticky nav (z-50) with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-black/80. Never hide links completely behind a hamburger on desktop.
layouts.hero_section: Full-bleed asymmetrical layout. Massive typography (H1). Overlay the background image with bg-black/50 (never darker, never fully opaque).
layouts.process_section: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. For the 4 steps (1. Brief, 2. Generate, 3. Rehearse, 4. Launch). Map them onto an asymmetric grid (e.g., col-span-8, col-span-4). Do not use equal sized boxes.
layouts.pricing_section: High contrast structural card for the ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 INR plan. Implement the 'Tracing Beam' style or a neon border.
layouts.contact_section: Solid functional grid. Massive typography for the email (samakung008@gmail.com) and phone (+917078415026). Make it impossible to miss.

rules: Use framer-motion for scroll reveals and staggered grid entry.
Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease). NEVER use 'transition: all'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add framer-motion @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
Use pure HTML/Tailwind (.jsx/.js) for structural marketing layouts rather than wrapping everything in Shadcn cards.
For the components, you are working with .js / .jsx files, NOT .tsx. Adapt your imports and syntax accordingly.
In App.css or index.css, ensure the font-families are correctly imported and mapped.
In Tailwind config, extend the colors to match the palette provided.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css (no text-align: center).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
